title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Explore free social spaces, cultural galleries, and student-led activities at Augustana University that require no admission or purchase.

cards.title: Browse the Eide/Dalrymple Gallery
cards.subtitle: Center for Visual Arts
cards.notes: View rotating exhibits and the Carl Grupp Permanent Collection. Admission is free for students and the public during gallery hours.
cards.short_summary: A free campus art gallery featuring professional and student exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The gallery is open to the public and handicapped accessible; admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Saturday 1 p.m. to 4 p.m. during the academic year.

cards.title: Visit the Center for Western Studies
cards.subtitle: Fantle Building
cards.notes: Explore Northern Plains history through free museum galleries and archives. No admission fee is required for visitors.
cards.short_summary: A research and museum center dedicated to the history and culture of the Northern Plains.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the CWS' art and museum galleries is free.
cards.source_title: CWS Frequently Asked Questions - Augustana University
cards.access_notes: Museum and galleries are open Monday-Friday from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

cards.title: Study at Mikkelsen Library
cards.subtitle: Campus Academic Hub
cards.notes: Utilize three floors of study spaces and tabletop games. The library is open to the public and provides free guest access.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus library offering collaborative and quiet study zones.
cards.evidence_claim: The library is open to the public and offers free guest access to resources.
cards.access_notes: Open late during the academic semester; check official site for current seasonal hours.

cards.title: Attend UBG Friday Night Events
cards.subtitle: Morrison Commons
cards.notes: Join free student-led social events every Friday night, ranging from movie screenings to live entertainment.
cards.short_summary: Weekly free social activities hosted by the student-led Union Board of Governors.
cards.evidence_claim: The Union Board of Governors (UBG) hosts free Friday night events.
cards.access_notes: Events typically held on Friday evenings during the academic year.

cards.title: Relax at the Outdoor Classroom
cards.subtitle: Near Froiland Science Complex
cards.notes: Sit on Sioux quartzite benches in this sustainable stone amphitheater. It is open for public use when not reserved for classes.
cards.short_summary: A sustainable outdoor learning and social space made of local South Dakota stone.
cards.evidence_claim: The classroom will cost nothing to heat, cool, or maintain and is open for student and community use.
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7; priority given to scheduled university classes.

cards.title: Work Out at the Elmen Center
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation Center
cards.notes: Use the pool, weight room, and indoor track for free with a valid student ID. No additional membership fee is required.
cards.short_summary: The primary fitness and recreation hub for Augustana students.
cards.evidence_claim: With an Augustana ID, you can use the weight room, pool or check out recreational equipment... at no cost.
cards.access_notes: Free access requires a valid Augustana University ID card.

cards.title: Walk Through the Augustana Garden
cards.subtitle: West 28th Street
cards.notes: Visit the student-run community garden to learn about sustainable food production. The space is open for students to interact and relax.
cards.short_summary: A community food collaborative and green space managed by students.
cards.evidence_claim: The garden provides an outdoor classroom for groups of students and community members to learn, interact or relax.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; best visited during daylight hours in the growing season.

cards.title: Hear the Augustana Bach Collegium
cards.subtitle: Our Savior's Lutheran Church
cards.notes: Attend free public concerts of Bach's sacred works performed by university ensembles at the nearby partner church.
cards.short_summary: Free classical music performances hosted in collaboration with a local church.
cards.evidence_claim: The Augustana Bach Collegium will perform its fall and spring events at OSL... free and available to the public.
cards.source_title: Augustana Partners With Our Savior's Lutheran Church to Host Bach Collegium
cards.access_notes: Check the School of Music calendar for specific performance dates.

cards.title: Hang Out in Morrison Commons
cards.subtitle: Student Union
cards.notes: Relax in the renovated 'pockets' of social space or the Back Alley. These areas are free for students to gather and socialize.
cards.short_summary: The central student union building featuring multiple free lounge areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The plan includes creating 'pockets' of smaller meeting spaces... designed to give students an alcohol-free environment.
cards.source_title: Augustana University Begins Phase II of Renovations to Morrison Commons
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the academic year; hours may vary during breaks.

cards.title: Watch Free Viking Athletics
cards.subtitle: Various Campus Venues
cards.notes: Attend home events for cross country, golf, swimming, tennis, and track & field for free. No ticket purchase is required for these sports.
cards.short_summary: Select Augustana University athletic competitions that are open to the public at no cost.
cards.evidence_claim: The following sports are free and open to the public for all home events: Cross Country, Golf, Swimming, Tennis, and Track & Field.
cards.source_title: Tickets for Gift Codes | vivenu - Augustana University
cards.access_notes: Check GoAugie.com for the current season schedule of free events.
